כְּ + לְ + קֳבֵל jointly carry the causal relation rendered 'Forasmuch'; no separate English part can be assigned to any of these three morphemes. Retain the indivisible residual expression as noncompositional with the first particle as display anchor (rules 6, 23, 30); the following דִּי separately takes 'as'.

Explicit complementizer דִּי takes the separately written subordinating 'as' (rules 2, 11, 30, 55). Assigning 'as' to the opening כְּ instead would leave the clause-linking דִּי without its recoverable rendering; the causal relation remains joint on 'Forasmuch'.

מן־קדם fused to 'of' (rule 30), headed on the opening preposition.

variant_decisions.evidence: Qere עֲלָךְ and ketiv עליך are two spellings of the same 2ms suffixed form 'to thee'; ASV 'to thee' renders either identically and no textual note is mapped to this unit. Base qere fallback retained.

Qere אֶחָךְ and ketiv אחיך are orthographic variants of 'thy brethren' with the same 2ms suffix; ASV 'thy brethren' renders either identically and no textual note is mapped to this unit. Base qere fallback retained.
